subject: Shinyapps.io large number of possible users

messages.author: 0337524813903e12
messages.subject: Shinyapps.io large number of possible users
parts:
I am considering the shinyapps.io professional plan because of the authentication feature. My app will have ~7k users who will access it not much more then 2 times in a year.

I would like to know if it’s possible to add ~7k authenticated users without typing each e-mail address like what’s documented here: http://docs.rstudio.com/shinyapps.io/authentication-and-user-management.html#user-authentication3

Thanks,
Daniel

messages.author: 4ed571196a3f42c8
messages.subject: Re: Shinyapps.io large number of possible users
parts:
Hi Daniel, 

Use the rsconnect::addAuthorizedUser function. I think you can only add one email address at a time, but you can loop over your 7k users easily (maybe add a pause on each iteration so you don't overwhelm the shinyapps API).

The most recent version from Github has an argument emailMessage which will allow you to specify a message to each user. Not sure if that has made it to CRAN yet.

Hope that helps, follow up if not.

-Mason
